# Anatomy model attribution and license

ASTHRAL redistributes the unmodified `zanatomy-muscles.glb` asset from `ArianArsenal/anatomy-explorer`, commit `8375d6ce7fec36e677c0eda66cae829ba55a4717`, file `public/models/muscles.glb`.

Required attribution:

> Z-Anatomy, the libre 3D atlas of anatomy, by Gauthier Kervyn and Marcin Zielinski, derived from BodyParts3D by the Database Center for Life Science (DBCLS). Muscular-system GLB converted for web distribution by ArianArsenal/anatomy-explorer. Used by ASTHRAL without modification.

The converted model is distributed under [Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). The underlying BodyParts3D dataset is attributed under [CC BY-SA 2.1 Japan](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.1/jp/). See the upstream [model license](https://github.com/Z-Anatomy/Models-of-human-anatomy/blob/master/License.txt) and [conversion project license notes](https://github.com/ArianArsenal/anatomy-explorer#credits--license).

ASTHRAL includes only the upstream muscular-system GLB. It does not redistribute the upstream organ layer or the separately licensed kidney model. This asset is a visual orientation aid; it is not a patient-specific model, clinical localization system, diagnostic atlas or clinically validated representation.
